slides.headline: PEOPLE ARE MAKING A WEEK OF CONTENT IN 20 MINUTES
slides.kicker: No agency. No blank page. Tonight.

slides.headline: 1) EXTRACT MULTIPLE ANGLES FROM ANY ROUGH IDEA
slides.body: Most business owners spend 2 hours deciding what to post. "Here is my rough idea: [idea]. Give me 3 different angles to post about. Write a one-sentence hook for each."

slides.headline: 2) TURN ONE ANGLE INTO AN INSTAGRAM CAROUSEL
slides.body: Writing a carousel from scratch takes 3 hours. This takes 2 minutes. "Turn this into a 6-slide carousel. Slide 1 = hook. Slides 2-5 = one insight each. Slide 6 = action step."

slides.headline: 3) WRITE A FULL EMAIL NEWSLETTER IN 5 MINUTES
slides.body: A weekly email newsletter takes most business owners 4 hours. "Turn this into a 200-word email. Subject line first. Casual tone. End with one question for replies."

slides.headline: 4) SCRIPT A 60-SECOND VIDEO IN ONE SHOT
slides.body: Video scripts take most people a full afternoon. "Turn this into a 60-second video script. Hook first. Three quick points. Close with a question that makes people comment."

slides.headline: 5) TURN ONE IDEA INTO A FULL WEEK OF LINKEDIN POSTS
slides.body: LinkedIn posts take professionals 2 hours each. "Rewrite this as 5 LinkedIn posts. Each one starts with a surprising first line. Different angle for each."

slides.headline: 6) GENERATE A MONTH OF ENGAGEMENT QUESTIONS
slides.body: Most business owners run out of content ideas within a week. "Based on this topic, write 15 short questions my audience would ask. Each short enough to post alone."

slides.headline: SAVE THIS. USE IT EVERY WEEK.
slides.body: Six prompts. One idea in. A full week of content out. Daily AI tools that actually work, right here

caption:
Swipe for all 6 prompts. These turn any rough idea into carousels, emails, video scripts, LinkedIn posts, and a month of engagement questions. 🗓️

Prompt 1 pulls 3 post angles from your roughest idea, Prompt 2 turns one angle into a full carousel script, Prompt 3 writes the newsletter with the subject line included, Prompt 4 scripts a 60-second video with hook and close built in, Prompt 5 rewrites the same idea as 5 different LinkedIn posts, Prompt 6 generates a month of questions your audience would actually ask.

Business owners are quietly replacing hours of weekly content work with a single 20-minute AI session. Most people who try this once never go back to writing from scratch.

editor_override: HOOK LAW — word count and completeness: 'PEOPLE ARE MAKING A WEEK OF CONTENT IN 20 MINUTES' is 10 words, below the 12-word minimum. More critically, it fails the SUMMARIZING COVER test: it gives no mechanism, no tool, no specifics beyond a time claim. The formula requires actor + what happened + the wild specifics. A reader can't repeat this to a friend with anything concrete behind it. Fix: expan
